name: Baltic Sea Simulator [MAP UPDATE!] │ALPHA
desc:
🚢 Set Sail in Baltic Sea Ship Simulator! Start your journey with a small vessel and work your way up to commanding an impressive fleet of ferries, general cargo, container, bulk carriers, cruise ships, and more! 🌊
Haul cargo, transport passengers, earn money, and explore ports across the Baltic Sea, including Helsinki, Tallinn, Mariehamn, Stockholm, Riga, Visby and more. Take on different routes, experience changing conditions at sea, and build your dream fleet.
With new ships, ports, routes, and features always on the horizon, there's always another voyage waiting for you. Are you ready to set sail and make your mark on the Baltic? 🚢

⚠️ATTENTION! The game is designed for true maritime enthusiasts. If you don't like grinding type of game - Don't buy! You are paying to test the game - bugs are expected.
✨ Stay tuned for awesome updates! ✨

Use code BETA2026 for 150k$ starting cash.

Don't forget to join our community!
